description: Synthetic meeting cases testing revisions, ownership, conditional decisions, causality, and unsupported details.

cases.evidence: At 09:10, the team proposed SQLite for the pilot. At 09:45, the team changed the plan and made a final decision to use PostgreSQL for the pilot.
cases.claim: PostgreSQL is the final database choice for the pilot.
cases.label: supported

cases.evidence: Sara said, 'I will prepare the initial security checklist.' Leo replied, 'I will review Sara's draft, but I am not writing it.'
cases.claim: Sara is responsible for drafting the initial security checklist.
cases.label: supported

cases.evidence: Deployment in December is possible if vendor testing passes. For now, the approved deployment target remains January.
cases.claim: The currently approved deployment target is January.
cases.label: supported

cases.evidence: The team agreed that 95th-percentile response latency must not exceed 2 seconds. No average latency target has been established.
cases.claim: The p95 response latency target is at most 2 seconds.
cases.label: supported

cases.evidence: The initial plan assigned API integration to Arun. In the final ownership review, Mei took over API integration and Arun was assigned to testing support.
cases.claim: Arun is the current owner of API integration.
cases.label: contradicted

cases.evidence: The team decided not to retain raw audio recordings after the meeting. Text transcripts will be retained for 30 days.
cases.claim: Raw meeting audio will be retained for 30 days.
cases.label: contradicted

cases.evidence: The demonstration was originally planned for December 5. The updated and approved schedule moves it to December 12.
cases.claim: The current demonstration date is December 5.
cases.label: contradicted

cases.evidence: The team explicitly rejected automatically sending extracted action items. Every action item must be reviewed before it is sent.
cases.claim: The team approved sending extracted action items without human review.
cases.label: contradicted

cases.evidence: The team compared OpenAI and Anthropic as possible evaluation providers. One member reported lower latency with Anthropic in an initial experiment.
cases.claim: The team selected Anthropic as its official evaluation provider.
cases.label: insufficient

cases.evidence: After the code update, the integration test passed. The team did not investigate which specific change affected the outcome.
cases.claim: The code update was proven to be the cause of the test passing.
cases.label: insufficient

cases.evidence: Authentication has been added to the application, and the team confirmed support for single sign-on.
cases.claim: The application implements SAML 2.0 single sign-on.
cases.label: insufficient

cases.evidence: Maya presented a proposed project budget of $5,000 during the meeting. The team discussed the proposal and associated cost categories.
cases.claim: The team formally approved a project budget of $5,000.
cases.label: insufficient
